protocol: Follow-up to preserved broader experiment: age correction restricted to matched provenance golden/pale35vs40, microshade correction restricted to same-provenance/age/tare amber/copper-only; brown step unchanged. These restrictions informed by observed collateral errors, validation remains exploratory. Three additive features: age35-vs40 cumulative step bounded0..2 baseline-radius units, brown->copper step0..2radius, copper->amber0..1 of available headroom below pure-shade meaningful radius. One older parameter, two dark parameters and three combined; joint objective same as prior. All fitting training-only with frozen v24 base weights/boundaries/context and original family splits extended label-free. Prior491 margins reproduce. Unresolved/missing axes never inferred. Pure5lb and zero golden/pale130 algebraically unchanged. Exploratory reused families; no prospective claim.
